
{{alias}}( [options] )
    Returns a title instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    options.align: string (optional)
        Horizontal text alignment of the title and subtitle.

    options.anchor: string (optional)
        Anchor position for placing the title and subtitle. Default: 'middle'.

    options.angle: number (optional)
        Angle (in degrees) of the title and subtitle text.

    options.aria: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output. Default: true.

    options.baseline: string (optional)
        Vertical baseline of the title and subtitle text.

    options.color: string (optional)
        Color of the title text.

    options.dx: number (optional)
        Horizontal offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle
        x-coordinate.

    options.dy: number (optional)
        Vertical offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle
        y-coordinate.

    options.encode: Object (optional)
        Mark encodings for custom title styling.

    options.font: string (optional)
        Font name of the title text.

    options.fontSize: number (optional)
        Font size of the title text.

    options.fontStyle: string (optional)
        Font style of the title text.

    options.fontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Font weight of the title text.

    options.frame: string (optional)
        Reference frame for the anchor position. Default: 'bounds'.

    options.limit: number (optional)
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of title and subtitle text.

    options.lineHeight: number (optional)
        Line height for multi-line title text.

    options.offset: number (optional)
        Orthogonal offset (in pixels) by which to displace the title from its
        position along the edge of the chart.

    options.orient: string (optional)
        Title orientation. Default: 'top'.

    options.subtitle: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Subtitle text.

    options.subtitleColor: string (optional)
        Color of the subtitle text.

    options.subtitleFont: string (optional)
        Font name for the subtitle text.

    options.subtitleFontSize: number (optional)
        Font size for the subtitle text.

    options.subtitleFontStyle: string (optional)
        Font style for the subtitle text.

    options.subtitleFontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Font weight for the subtitle text.

    options.subtitleLineHeight: number (optional)
        Line height for multi-line subtitle text.

    options.subtitlePadding: number (optional)
        Padding (in pixels) between title and subtitle text.

    options.text: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Title text. Default: [].

    options.zindex: integer (optional)
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the title group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: 0.

    Returns
    -------
    title: Title
        Title instance.

    title.align
        Horizontal text alignment of the title and subtitle.

    title.anchor
        Anchor position for placing the title and subtitle.

    title.angle
        Angle (in degrees) of the title and subtitle text.

    title.aria
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output.

    title.baseline
        Vertical baseline of the title and subtitle text.

    title.color
        Color of the title text.

    title.dx
        Horizontal offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle
        x-coordinate.

    title.dy
        Vertical offset (in pixels) added to the title and subtitle
        y-coordinate.

    title.encode
        Mark encodings for custom title styling.

    title.font
        Font name of the title text.

    title.fontSize
        Font size of the title text.

    title.fontStyle
        Font style of the title text.

    title.fontWeight
        Font weight of the title text.

    title.frame
        Reference frame for the anchor position.

    title.limit
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of title and subtitle text.

    title.lineHeight
        Line height for multi-line title text.

    title.offset
        Orthogonal offset (in pixels) by which to displace the title from its
        position along the edge of the chart.

    title.orient
        Title orientation.

    title.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    title.subtitle
        Subtitle text.

    title.subtitleColor
        Color of the subtitle text.

    title.subtitleFont
        Font name for the subtitle text.

    title.subtitleFontSize
        Font size for the subtitle text.

    title.subtitleFontStyle
        Font style for the subtitle text.

    title.subtitleFontWeight
        Font weight for the subtitle text.

    title.subtitleLineHeight
        Line height for multi-line subtitle text.

    title.subtitlePadding
        Padding (in pixels) between title and subtitle text.

    title.text
        Title text.

    title.zindex
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the title group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups.

    title.toJSON()
        Serializes a title instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var title = new {{alias}}()
    <Title>

    // Provide options at instantiation:
    > title = new {{alias}}( { 'text': 'Beep boop', 'anchor': 'start' } )
    <Title>
    > title.anchor
    'start'

    // Set a property:
    > title.orient = 'bottom';
    > title.orient
    'bottom'

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > title.toJSON()
    {...}

    See Also
    --------
